annotations.title: Read my plan and today's AI allowances

description: Read the signed-in account's plan ("free", "pro" or "ultra") and today's allowance of each metered AI feature: limit, used and remaining, all resetting at resets_at (UTC). paid_until is the end of the current paid period (it may renew; see plan_url). Here the metered feature is "auto-apply" (applications prepared for review): starting one for a new posting uses one; retrying, reviewing or cancelling an existing attempt, or starting the same posting again, uses nothing. The others ("tailor", "match", "cover-letter", "assistant", "dictation") are used on the website. The free plan includes no AI features and is refused every new auto-apply: tell the person to upgrade at plan_url rather than retrying. On a paid plan, an enforced limit with nothing remaining refuses new starts until resets_at; an unenforced limit is only measured, so it carries no remaining. An unlimited feature still has a high fair-use cap. Prices and payments are not shown; they are on plan_url. Takes no arguments.
